business_model.claim: Okta sells cloud identity software through two platforms, the Okta Platform and the Auth0 Platform, covering workforce identity and customer identity.
quotes: We are the leading independent identity partner.

business_model.claim: Customers are organizations of all sizes, from large enterprises to small businesses, universities, nonprofits and government agencies. The 10-K counts more than 20,000 of them.
quotes: As of January 31, 2026, more than 20,000 customers across nearly every industry used our solutions to secure and manage identities around the world.

quotes: Our revenue is relatively predictable as a result of our subscription-based business model, which constituted approximately 98% of total revenue for fiscal 2026.

business_model.claim: Okta reports as one reportable segment.

quotes: We base subscription fees primarily on the solutions used and the number of users on our platforms.
We typically invoice customers in advance in annual installments for subscriptions to our platforms.

business_model.claim: Subscription revenue growth is driven by customer count, users per customer and the solutions each customer uses. Expansion within existing customers is measured by dollar-based net retention, which fell to 106% at January 31, 2026 from 107% a year earlier.
quotes: Subscription revenue is driven primarily by the number of customers, the number of users per customer and the solutions used.

The decrease in our Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate as of January 31, 2026, compared to January 31, 2025, was primarily a result of the macroeconomic environment, with overall ACV from existing customers increasing at a slower rate in the current period.
